about: watch_page mutants (design feature-logs/watch-page-shell/design.md §6.6). Read by run.ps1 -Plan watch_page; schema in run.ps1's header and below. The entries are written in a later part of S0b; the two below are EXAMPLES (example: true), skipped by the runner.

schema.phases: -Phase -> the landing steps ("landing") whose mutants run in it
schema.prefs: k:type=v written with --pref into every run (unless the field table's run says planPrefs false); a table's own prefs override by key
schema.media: files or folders outside the repository the runs read (offline media, models), hashed into every report folder's manifest; ${AsrModels} = -AsrModels, %VAR% expanded, relative = from the repository root

mutant.location: file:line the patch changes (S1 rewrites it; -CheckTestSide ignores it)
mutant.change: what the patch does, with its source
mutant.landing: the step it is written in (§6.6 「落地」): S0, S1b, S1c or S2
mutant.catcher: the design's 「抓它的检查」, as text
mutant.catchers: [{check: <field table id>, expected: [<field names of that table>, or "uiErrorKeys"]}]: caught when an expected field differs from the unmutated baseline; the fields must name the mutant in expectedFor
mutant.uncovered: optional: why no check can reach it (未覆盖): listed, not run

prefsAbout: design §5 「变异 runner 每次新建 profile：设置」: every key by its storage key, with the type lib/utils/self_test_pref.dart settingTypes reads it as. Pinned so that nothing depends on the window or the machine: horizontalScreen true (unset, its first read writes isTablet, the window's shortest side >= 600, storage_pref.dart:827-835; the branches of §6.1 need it on), horizontalSeasonPanel true (its default is horizontalScreen, :575-578), fullScreenMode 0 = auto, a value that rotates (unset, the first read writes none when horizontalScreen && isTablet, :233-242; none and gravity make changeOrientation return). The rest are the app's own defaults written out: enableVerticalExpand false (:892), defaultShowComment false (:1178), showVideoReply true (:442), showBangumiReply true (:567), showRelatedVideo true (:439), preInitPlayer false (:677), keyboardControl true (:1273), darkVideoPage false (:750), removeSafeArea false (:1343), autoPiP false (:1005), showWindowTitleBar true (:1279), hideInteraction true (:564). A check that needs another value sets it in its table's run.prefs (merged by key, the table's last): e.g. enableVerticalExpand true for the three-column / split 9:16 rows, horizontalScreen false for R7h and R15a, defaultShowComment true for R4a, horizontalMemberPage true for the UP popup (K1), transcription on for R9c.
materials: wp_materials.json: the online ids with the evidence each was chosen on, and the offline snapshots (test/fixtures/watch_page/<name>; a field table uses one as run.profile "snapshot:test/fixtures/watch_page/<name>")
